measures.name: CO2 (t)
measures.description: Total CO2 emitted in the EU MRV scope, in tonnes.

measures.name: Fuel (t)
measures.description: Total fuel burned in the EU MRV scope, in tonnes.

measures.name: Distance (nm)
measures.description: Distance sailed in the MRV scope, in nautical miles (total fuel divided by fuel per nautical mile).

measures.name: Hours at Sea
measures.description: Time at sea in the MRV scope, in hours.

measures.name: Ships Reporting
measures.description: Number of distinct ships with an MRV report in the current filter.

measures.name: Ship-Years
measures.description: Number of ship-year reports.

measures.name: Quality-Checked Share
measures.dax: DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Ship Year Emissions'), 'Ship Year Emissions'[Passes Quality Checks] = TRUE()), COUNTROWS('Ship Year Emissions'))
measures.description: Share of ship-years whose distance, speed and carbon factor are physically plausible. Efficiency measures use only these.

measures.name: CO2 per nm (kg)
measures.dax: CALCULATE(DIVIDE(SUM('Ship Year Emissions'[co2_t]) * 1000, SUM('Ship Year Emissions'[distance_nm])), KEEPFILTERS('Ship Year Emissions'[Passes Quality Checks] = TRUE()))
measures.description: Kilograms of CO2 per nautical mile: total CO2 divided by total distance, over quality-checked ship-years. Lower is better.

measures.name: Fuel per nm (kg)
measures.dax: CALCULATE(DIVIDE(SUM('Ship Year Emissions'[fuel_t]) * 1000, SUM('Ship Year Emissions'[distance_nm])), KEEPFILTERS('Ship Year Emissions'[Passes Quality Checks] = TRUE()))
measures.description: Kilograms of fuel per nautical mile over quality-checked ship-years.

measures.name: Average Speed (kn)
measures.dax: CALCULATE(DIVIDE(SUM('Ship Year Emissions'[distance_nm]), SUM('Ship Year Emissions'[hours_at_sea])), KEEPFILTERS('Ship Year Emissions'[Passes Quality Checks] = TRUE()))
measures.description: Average speed in knots: distance divided by hours at sea, over quality-checked ship-years.

measures.name: CO2 per Tonne-Mile (g)
measures.dax: CALCULATE(DIVIDE(SUM('Ship Year Emissions'[co2_t]) * 1000000, SUM('Ship Year Emissions'[transport_work_tonne_nm])), KEEPFILTERS('Ship Year Emissions'[Passes Quality Checks] = TRUE()), KEEPFILTERS(NOT ISBLANK('Ship Year Emissions'[transport_work_tonne_nm])))
measures.description: Grams of CO2 per tonne of cargo carried one nautical mile, for ship-years that report transport work by cargo mass.

measures.name: Carbon Factor (t CO2 per t fuel)
measures.description: Tonnes of CO2 per tonne of fuel. About 3.11 for heavy fuel oil and lower for LNG.

measures.name: CO2 in EU ETS Scope (t)
measures.description: CO2 counted under the EU ETS rules: 100% of voyages between EEA ports and at berth, 50% of voyages into or out of the EEA.

measures.name: EU ETS Scope Share
measures.description: Share of MRV CO2 that falls under the EU ETS scope rules.

measures.name: Allowances Due (t)
measures.description: Allowances to surrender: CO2 in scope times the phase-in share (40% for 2024, 70% for 2025, 100% from 2026). Zero before 2024.

measures.name: EU ETS Cost (EUR)
measures.description: Allowances due times the average EU ETS price of the same year, in euros.

measures.name: EU ETS Cost per Ship (EUR)
measures.description: EU ETS cost divided by the number of ships reporting.

measures.name: EU ETS Cost at Scenario Price (EUR)
measures.dax: [CO2 in EU ETS Scope (t)] * [Carbon Price Scenario Value]
measures.description: Full-scope EU ETS cost (100% surrender, the rule from 2026) at the carbon price chosen with the Carbon Price Scenario parameter.

measures.name: Average EUA Price (EUR/t)
measures.description: Average daily EU ETS allowance price in the selected period, EUR per tonne of CO2.

measures.name: Latest EUA Price (EUR/t)
measures.dax: VAR d = CALCULATE(MAX('Carbon Price'[date_key]), 'Carbon Price') RETURN CALCULATE(AVERAGE('Carbon Price'[eua_price_eur_per_t]), 'Carbon Price'[date_key] = d)
measures.description: EU ETS allowance price on the last day in the selected period.

measures.name: EUA Price Range (EUR/t)
measures.description: Highest minus lowest daily price in the selected period.

measures.name: Rated Ship-Years
measures.dax: CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Ship Year Emissions'), KEEPFILTERS(NOT ISBLANK('Ship Year Emissions'[CII Rating])))
measures.description: Ship-years with a CII rating (needs gross tonnage and a reduction factor for the year).

measures.name: Share Rated D or E
measures.dax: DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Ship Year Emissions'), KEEPFILTERS('Ship Year Emissions'[CII Rating] IN {"D", "E"})), [Rated Ship-Years])
measures.description: Share of rated ship-years with a D or E rating. Under IMO rules, a D for three years in a row or one E requires a corrective plan.

measures.name: Share Rated A or B
measures.dax: DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Ship Year Emissions'), KEEPFILTERS('Ship Year Emissions'[CII Rating] IN {"A", "B"})), [Rated Ship-Years])
measures.description: Share of rated ship-years with an A or B rating.

measures.name: Average CII Ratio
measures.description: Average of attained CII divided by required CII. Below 1 is better than required.

measures.name: Ships with Worsening Rating
measures.dax: CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(SUMMARIZE('Ship Year Emissions', Ship[ship_key])), KEEPFILTERS('Ship Year Emissions'[Rating Worsened] = TRUE()))
measures.description: Ships whose rating letter is worse than in the previous year.

measures.name: Port Calls
measures.description: Number of AIS-derived port calls.

measures.name: Median Waiting Time (h)
measures.description: Median hours at anchor before berthing, over all calls (calls without waiting count as zero).

measures.name: Average Waiting Time when Waiting (h)
measures.dax: CALCULATE(AVERAGE('Port Calls'[waiting_hours]), KEEPFILTERS('Port Calls'[Had Waiting] = TRUE()))
measures.description: Average hours at anchor for the calls that did wait.

measures.name: Share of Calls with Waiting
measures.dax: DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Port Calls'), KEEPFILTERS('Port Calls'[Had Waiting] = TRUE())), [Port Calls])
measures.description: Share of port calls with anchorage waiting before berthing.

measures.name: Total Waiting Time (h)
measures.description: Total hours at anchor before berthing.

measures.name: Median Berth Time (h)
measures.description: Median hours alongside the quay per call.

measures.name: Calls Confirmed by Kystverket
measures.dax: DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Port Calls'), 'Port Calls'[Confirmed by Kystverket] = TRUE(), 'Port Calls'[Cut by Data Window] = FALSE()), CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Port Calls'), 'Port Calls'[Cut by Data Window] = FALSE()))
measures.description: Share of AIS-derived calls that Kystverket's own port call records confirm within 12 hours.

measures.name: Voyage Legs
measures.description: Number of voyage legs between port calls.

measures.name: Legs Arriving
measures.dax: CALCULATE([Voyage Legs], USERELATIONSHIP('Voyage Legs'[destination_port_id], Port[Port Key]))
measures.description: Voyage legs that end in the port in view (uses the inactive destination relationship; Voyage Legs counts legs that start there).

measures.name: Leg Distance (nm)
measures.description: Distance sailed along the AIS track.

measures.name: Leg Speed (kn)
measures.description: Average speed while under way (3 knots or more).

measures.name: Average Wind (m/s)
measures.dax: DIVIDE(SUMX('Voyage Legs', 'Voyage Legs'[avg_wind_ms] * 'Voyage Legs'[steaming_hours]), CALCULATE(SUM('Voyage Legs'[steaming_hours]), NOT ISBLANK('Voyage Legs'[avg_wind_ms])))
measures.description: Average 10 m wind speed along the legs, weighted by steaming hours.

measures.name: Average Wave Height (m)
measures.dax: DIVIDE(SUMX('Voyage Legs', 'Voyage Legs'[avg_wave_m] * 'Voyage Legs'[steaming_hours]), CALCULATE(SUM('Voyage Legs'[steaming_hours]), NOT ISBLANK('Voyage Legs'[avg_wave_m])))
measures.description: Average significant wave height along the legs, weighted by steaming hours.

measures.name: Rough Weather Share
measures.dax: DIVIDE(SUMX('Voyage Legs', 'Voyage Legs'[rough_share] * 'Voyage Legs'[steaming_hours]), CALCULATE(SUM('Voyage Legs'[steaming_hours]), NOT ISBLANK('Voyage Legs'[rough_share])))
measures.description: Share of steaming time in wind of 10.8 m/s or more (Beaufort 6) or waves of 2.5 m or more.

measures.name: Speed Elasticity
measures.dax: VAR p = SELECTEDVALUE('Speed Relation'[Parameter Key], "speed_elasticity_mrv") RETURN CALCULATE(MAX('Model Parameters'[Value]), 'Model Parameters'[Parameter] = p, 'Model Parameters'[Parameter Segment] = "All")
measures.description: Exponent b in CO2 per nautical mile ~ speed^b, from the Speed Relation choice: estimated from MRV data across ships (default, conservative) or the engineering rule b = 2.

measures.name: Scenario CO2 (t)
measures.description: CO2 if every ship sailed the same distance at the changed speed: CO2 times (1 + speed change) to the power of the elasticity.

measures.name: CO2 Saved (t)
measures.description: CO2 avoided in the speed scenario.

measures.name: Fuel Cost Saved (EUR)
measures.dax: ([Fuel (t)] - [Fuel (t)] * POWER(1 + [Speed Change Value], [Speed Elasticity])) * [Fuel Price Value]
measures.description: Fuel saved in the speed scenario times the fuel price chosen with the Fuel Price parameter.

measures.name: EU ETS Cost Saved (EUR)
measures.dax: [CO2 Saved (t)] * [EU ETS Scope Share] * [Carbon Price Scenario Value]
measures.description: CO2 saved that falls under the EU ETS scope, at the scenario carbon price and full (2026) surrender.

measures.name: Extra Sailing Days
measures.description: Added days at sea to cover the same distance at the changed speed, summed over ships. The trade-off for the savings.

measures.name: Extra Days per Ship
measures.description: Added days at sea per ship and year in the speed scenario.

measures.name: Efficiency Rank
measures.dax: IF(HASONEVALUE(Ship[Ship]) && NOT ISBLANK([CO2 per nm (kg)]), RANKX(FILTER(ALLSELECTED(Ship[Ship]), NOT ISBLANK([CO2 per nm (kg)])), [CO2 per nm (kg)], , ASC, DENSE))
measures.description: Rank of the ship by CO2 per nautical mile among the ships in view, 1 = lowest CO2 per mile.

measures.name: Segment Peer CO2 per nm (kg)
measures.dax: VAR seg = SELECTEDVALUE(Ship[Ship Segment]) RETURN CALCULATE([CO2 per nm (kg)], REMOVEFILTERS(Ship), Ship[Ship Segment] = seg)
measures.description: CO2 per nautical mile of all ships in the same segment, for comparison with one ship.

measures.name: Variance vs Segment Peers
measures.dax: IF(NOT ISBLANK([CO2 per nm (kg)]), DIVIDE([CO2 per nm (kg)] - [Segment Peer CO2 per nm (kg)], [Segment Peer CO2 per nm (kg)]))
measures.description: How much more (positive) or less (negative) CO2 per mile the ship emits than its segment.

measures.name: Size-Class Peer CO2 per nm (kg)
measures.dax: VAR seg = SELECTEDVALUE(Ship[Ship Segment]) VAR sz = SELECTEDVALUE(Ship[Size Class]) RETURN CALCULATE([CO2 per nm (kg)], REMOVEFILTERS(Ship), Ship[Ship Segment] = seg, Ship[Size Class] = sz)
measures.description: CO2 per nautical mile of ships in the same segment and size class.

measures.name: Variance vs Size-Class Peers
measures.dax: IF(NOT ISBLANK([CO2 per nm (kg)]), DIVIDE([CO2 per nm (kg)] - [Size-Class Peer CO2 per nm (kg)], [Size-Class Peer CO2 per nm (kg)]))
measures.description: How much more or less CO2 per mile the ship emits than ships of its segment and size class.

measures.name: Ship Label
measures.description: Name of the ship in view (its pseudonym), for tooltips and page headers.

measures.name: Selected Scope Label
measures.description: Text label summarising the current selection, for page headers.

measures.name: Speed Change Value
measures.description: What-if parameter: speed change applied to every ship (negative = slower).

measures.name: Carbon Price Scenario Value
measures.description: What-if parameter: EU ETS allowance price in EUR per tonne for the scenarios.

measures.name: Fuel Price Value
measures.description: What-if parameter: fuel price in EUR per tonne (default 550, a documented assumption).

tables.name: Date
tables.description: Calendar from 2018 to the data end date (30 September 2026). Marked as the date table.

tables.name: Segment
tables.description: Fleet segment: vehicle carriers or ro-ro ships. Conformed dimension shared by all fact tables.

tables.name: Ship
tables.description: Pseudonymous ships, one row per ship version (slowly changing type 2). No names or IMO numbers.

tables.name: Port
tables.description: Norwegian ports at UN/LOCODE level from the Kystverket location register.

tables.name: Ship Year Emissions
tables.description: Fact table. Grain: one row per ship and EU MRV reporting year (2018 to 2025). Linked to the date table on 31 December of the year.

tables.name: Port Calls
tables.description: Fact table. Grain: one AIS-derived port call in Norway (ship, port, berth period), August to September 2026.

tables.name: Voyage Legs
tables.description: Fact table. Grain: one voyage leg between two consecutive port calls of the same ship on the Norwegian coast, with weather.

tables.name: Carbon Price
tables.description: Fact table. Grain: one row per day. EU ETS allowance price (front December contract) in EUR per tonne of CO2.

tables.name: Model Parameters
tables.description: Parameters estimated by the analysis (for example the speed elasticity of fuel per nautical mile) with their uncertainty intervals.

calculation_group.dax: VAR cur = SELECTEDMEASURE() VAR py = CALCULATE(SELECTEDMEASURE(), SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR('Date'[Date])) RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(cur) && NOT ISBLANK(py), cur - py)
VAR cur = SELECTEDMEASURE() VAR py = CALCULATE(SELECTEDMEASURE(), SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR('Date'[Date])) RETURN DIVIDE(cur - py, py)

what_if.name: Speed Change
what_if.description: What-if parameter: speed change applied to every ship (negative = slower).

what_if.name: Carbon Price Scenario
what_if.description: What-if parameter: EU ETS allowance price in EUR per tonne for the scenarios.

what_if.name: Fuel Price
what_if.description: What-if parameter: fuel price in EUR per tonne (default 550, a documented assumption).

roles.name: Vehicle Carriers Only
roles.description: Sees only vehicle carriers and their port calls and voyages.

roles.name: Ro-ro Ships Only
roles.description: Sees only ro-ro ships and their port calls and voyages.

bpa_exceptions.ENSURE_TABLES_HAVE_RELATIONSHIPS: Disconnected by design: parameter, selector, measure and calculation group tables.
bpa_exceptions.REDUCE_USAGE_OF_CALCULATED_TABLES: What-if parameters and field parameters are calculated tables by definition.
bpa_exceptions.REMOVE_ROLES_WITH_NO_MEMBERS: Members are assigned in the Power BI service after publishing, never in the project files.
bpa_exceptions.DAX_MEASURES_UNQUALIFIED: Field parameters require NAMEOF with a fully qualified measure reference.
bpa_exceptions.INTEGER_FORMATTING: Ratios, prices and elasticities need two or three decimals to be readable.
